_comment: Single source of the creative-lab vocabulary. DNA, style and job schemas reference these lists via x-enumRef. Add values here (never inline in code). Descriptions are what the analyst (Claude) and the UI show.

archetypes.label: Offer stack
archetypes.desc: Price + crossed price + bundle/gift + COD/delivery stacked as the message; product is proof.

archetypes.label: Bundle reveal
archetypes.desc: Pack contents revealed item by item (bag → shoes → gift).

archetypes.label: Colour range
archetypes.desc: All colourways side by side / sequential; choice is the hook.

archetypes.label: Studio showcase
archetypes.desc: Clean studio hero shots, turntable/orbit, premium light.

archetypes.label: Detail close-up
archetypes.desc: Macro on texture, hardware, stitching, inside lining — quality proof.

archetypes.label: In-hand demo
archetypes.desc: Hands open/close, show capacity, straps, what fits inside.

archetypes.label: On-model lifestyle
archetypes.desc: Worn/carried by a person in a real setting (street, café, event).

archetypes.label: UGC review
archetypes.desc: Customer/creator talking or reacting to camera, phone-shot, testimonial.

archetypes.label: Unboxing
archetypes.desc: Parcel/box opened, product revealed — delivery reassurance.

archetypes.label: Outfit pairing
archetypes.desc: Bag/shoes matched to outfits; 'goes with everything'.

archetypes.label: Comparison
archetypes.desc: Us vs them, boutique price vs ours, before/after organisation.

archetypes.label: Social proof
archetypes.desc: Reviews, order screenshots, delivery photos, counts.

archetypes.label: New drop / scarcity
archetypes.desc: New collection, limited stock, back in stock.

archetypes.label: Gift angle
archetypes.desc: Framed as a gift (for her, occasion, Eid/wedding season).

archetypes.label: Craft / origin
archetypes.desc: Made locally, workshop, materials, behind the scenes.

archetypes.label: Store / stock tour
archetypes.desc: Shelves, warehouse, many models — abundance and trust.

archetypes.label: Trend / meme
archetypes.desc: Native trend format, audio meme, POV skit.

archetypes.label: Typographic
archetypes.desc: Text-led static or motion text over minimal visual.

archetypes.label: Catalog grid
archetypes.desc: Many products in a grid/collage with prices.

hook_types.desc: Price (often with crossed price) is the first thing seen.
Product appears/revealed with motion in the first second.
Unexpected visual/action that stops the scroll.
On-screen or spoken question to the viewer.
Strong statement (quality, best, original) — check policy.
Fast zoom/orbit/whip on the product from frame 0.
Person reacting/speaking to camera in frame 0.
Withholds the payoff (what's inside, which colour).

shot_types.desc: Product from a 3/4 or side angle.
Product placed in a real-world scene.
All pack items together (bag + shoes + gift).
Parcel opened — ONLY with real packaging photos.
Graphic card (offer, price, list) — rendered, never generated.

generation_strategies.desc: Must be filmed for real (hands unboxing, try-on, demo, talking). Emits a shoot request; never generated.
Real photo moved by the editor (push/pan/parallax) — zero generated pixels.
Real cut-out composited on an AI background plate; camera motion in Remotion.
L1 + AI relight/shadow of the flattened composite, then the real cut-out pasted back.
Reference-conditioned edit (product held/worn); strict identity QA.
Several real references (pack pieces/colourways) composed in one scene; strict QA.
Image-to-video from a REAL first frame (L0/L1 still); camera-only motion, ≤5 s, audio off.
Reference-to-video with a person (neck-down, no dialogue); highest risk, strict QA.
Rendered by Remotion (cards, price, end card).

qa_dimensions.desc: Shape, colour, material, hardware, logo/brand marks match the reference photos.
No warping, melting, morphing, extra straps/handles, broken hands/fingers.
Subject placement, safe zones respected, crop works for the placement.
Matches the style card / reference DNA intent.
Looks like SIRINE (premium-minimal, warm), not generic AI stock.
Overlay text readable on mobile, correct Arabic shaping, correct digits.
No prohibited claims/personal-attribute phrasing; AI-disclosure needs noted.
